newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Dec qtr capital spending falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Dec qtr capital spending falls.

text.p: Australian private new capital expenditure fell 2.4 percent, seasonally-adjusted, in the December quarter to an estimated A$10.27 billion from A$10.52 billion in the September quarter, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with A$8.59 billion a year earlier. Figures are at average 1989/90 prices.

The fifth estimate for capex in 1996/97 is A$43.00 billion, compared with the fourth estimate of A$42.91 billion. The first estimate for 1997/98 was A$34.68 billion, a rise of 10.1 percent over the first estimate for 1996/97.
